defects.title: Navigation smoke masked mocked bootstrap console noise with broad SSE string filters
defects.observed: The navigation spec collected console errors and filtered any message containing EventSource, SSE, or event stream before asserting success.
defects.intended: The mocked bootstrap harness should run cleanly and the navigation smoke should fail on unexpected console or page errors instead of hiding them by substring.
defects.resolution: The navigation error assertion now uses the shared attachRuntimeErrorGuards helper with no allowConsole entries, covering console errors and uncaught page errors.
